items.phrase: Did you have a good weekend?
items.example: Did you have a good weekend? — Not bad, thanks.
items.mnemonic: Викенд удался: did you have a good weekend — как прошли выходные.

items.example: How was your weekend? — It was great.
items.mnemonic: Воз выходных: how was your weekend — как прошли выходные.

items.example: What did you do at the weekend?
items.mnemonic: Дед спрашивает what did you do — что ты делал.

items.example: Where did you go? — We went to the beach.
items.mnemonic: С веером ищут where did you go — куда ты ходил.

items.example: Who did you go with? — With my sister and two friends.
items.mnemonic: Хвост компании: who did you go with — с кем ты ходил.

items.example: You didn't like the film? Why was that?
items.mnemonic: Вайфай пропал: why was that — почему так.
Хэппи-энд сорвался: what happened — что случилось.

items.example: Did you go swimming? — Me too!
items.mnemonic: Туфли тоже пошли купаться: me too — я тоже.

items.example: What did you do on Sunday? — Nothing special.
items.mnemonic: Нафаня разводит руками: nothing special — ничего особенного.

items.example: You walked ten miles? That sounds awful!
items.mnemonic: Саундтрек на десять миль: that sounds awful — звучит ужасно.

items.example: How was your weekend? — Not bad.
items.mnemonic: Бедствия не было: not bad — неплохо.

items.example: Find three things that you both did.
items.mnemonic: В комоде ищут find three things in common — найти три общего.
